metadata.identity: Haute Couture::The Crimson God of Le Rouge Sinclair
metadata.frame_convention: Zero-based decoded source frame; time_s = frame * 1001 / 30000. End frames exclusive. Native source is 29.970 fps, not exactly 30.
metadata.units: BH = visible standing body height of caster in same shot, excluding halo/cape spread. Distances are screen-plane estimates, not calibrated world coordinates.
metadata.precision: Native-window events identify individual frames. Other boundaries from 6/15 fps are explicitly approximate (usually +/-2 frames for 15 fps, +/-5 for 6 fps). Flash-obscured contact is bracketed; no invisible collision or coin boundary is asserted.
metadata.colors: Hex values are visual approximations under bloom/compression, not sampled material albedos.
metadata.mapping_policy: Supplied kit is the authority for names, Pierce type and coin counts. No skill-name/coin UI is readable; mapping confidence is separate from visual confidence. Repeated VFX pulses are not counted automatically as coins.

candidate_name: Form change associated with La Fin de l'Enfance / Noble Dignity (exact trigger unverified)
mapping_confidence: high form continuity; low exact passive trigger

before.type: Bare-hand/orb casting; no held firearm or edged weapon visible
before.size_BH: Hand-sized emission .15–.3; suspended red orb cluster .3–.6
before.holding: One hand extended toward recipient; two arms raise for barrage; no shouldering/grip
before.parts_colors: Pale hand; olive/gold cape #A58B43; white/pink clothes #F4DFDA. Red spell nodes #EF2445, cream cores #FFF0DC.

after.type: Flexible chain carrying repeating paired crescent/axe-shaped links; skeletal claw gauntlet
after.size_BH: Gauntlet forearm/claws .5–.8; link .15–.3; deployed chain typically3–5; cape/ribs enlarge apparent silhouette
after.holding: Chain curves from hand/arm area; mostly one-arm lash with other arm extended. Some grip is hidden by cape. No rigid two-handed greatsword swing established.
after.parts_colors: Ivory/pink edged paired crescents #E4CDD0, dark central chain #3C1521, red inner facets #9D1832; skeletal ivory claw fingers over red glove, black/red ribbed cloak.

occurrences.hits_vs_coins: 0 confirmed target hits; transformation flashes are self-centered
